Name: Shardust's Fences Gate Flooring for Content Patcher - the 1.6 update
Author: Shardust
Description:
[center][u][b][color=#ea9999][size=5][color=#ffffff][size=4]An Alternative Textures version is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11804]available here[/url]﻿ though it only has the color and texture options (so no vines/flowers/winter overlays, and no Hedge's seasonal variants.[/size][/color]

SHARDUST'S FENCES GATE FLOORING 
June 2026 update[/size][/color][/b][/u][/center]
[u][b]
Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher and was tested with the latest STABLE (at the time of the upload) version of the game, SMAPI, Content Patcher. [/b][/u]

This a series of retextures of the game's Fences, Gate and Flooring, with several colors available for each. 
Each item has been either recolored or retextured and has several different options available. 
Their respective in-game icons will change along with them.
You can change one of the fences into an Hedge, and have it with a base or being full grass, with or without flowery decoration.

The mods with Foliage decor available (Fences, Gate, Hedge overlay) have optional compatibility patches where the color will dynamically change with the seasons, and according to whichever map recolor you have installed (or not, in which case it'll be the base game's seasonal colors). 
The only available patches will be those that were already available in older versions of my mods, from Map Recolors that are still downloadable from NexusMods, and have either open permissions for compatibility patches or gave consent when previously asked. ONLY -colors- were picked, NOT textures or code or other.
Please do your own research if said mods require unofficial updates/patches/compatibility to keep working, and be careful of offsite downloads.
If permissions are ever revoked in the future, I will remove the corresponding patch from the mod.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor[/url] (acerbicon)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] (DaisyNiko)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8372]Rosier Colored Glasses[/url] (vamoosi)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] (Lita/strangelyliteral)
and
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial[/url] (CherrySymphony)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone - Foliage Only[/url] (Dustbeauty)
and
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26027](CP) Dustbeauty's Stardew Foliage and Recolor[/url] (Novaphene)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] (grapeponta + Semisu + Pooh)

My deepest thanks to SpringSong and all the peeps in the official Stardew Valley Discord for all the help wit the coding et all!
